definitions: To throw a rider by arching its back and kicking out its hind legs (of a horse or other animal).
To move or cause to move with a sudden jerky motion.
To remove the antlers from a deer.
To saw wood into shorter lengths.
examples: He decided to buck the trend.
The horse began to buck wildly.
The boat bucked in the rough seas.
They bucked the deer after the hunt.
He spent the afternoon bucking logs.
